where.ko: 인터넷등기소 iros.go.kr — 주소만 알면 누구나 약 700원에 직접 발급
where.en: iros.go.kr — anyone can issue it for about 700 won with just the address

desc.ko: 가장 중요한 서류입니다. 상대방이 보여주는 것을 믿지 말고, 계약 당일 아침에 직접 발급하세요.
desc.en: The single most important document. Don't rely on their copy — issue it yourself on the morning of signing.

ko: 갑구: 소유자 이름이 계약할 사람과 정확히 같은지
최근 소유권 이전일 — 며칠 전 바뀌었다면 주의
en: Section 갑구: owner's name matches the person signing, exactly
Section 갑구: any seizure, attachment, injunction, auction or trust entry
Section 을구: the maximum lien amount of any mortgage
(lien + your deposit) ÷ market value ≤ 70%
Recent ownership transfer date — a change days ago is a warning
Header: address, building and unit number match the actual room

q.ko: 등기부등본상 소유자와 계약 상대방의 이름이 다릅니까?
q.en: Does the registered owner's name differ from the person signing?
Is (mortgage lien + deposit) more than 70% of market value?

q.ko: 신탁, 가압류, 압류, 경매 관련 기재가 있습니까?
q.en: Is there any trust, seizure, attachment or auction entry?
Have you not yet issued the register yourself?

desc.ko: 건물의 법적 용도와 위반 여부를 보여줍니다. 주거용이 아니면 전입신고와 보증보험이 막힐 수 있습니다.
desc.en: Shows the building's legal use and any violations. If it isn't residential, move-in registration and deposit insurance can be blocked.

ko: 실제 호수와 대장상 호수가 같은지 (쪼개기 여부)
사용승인일 — 너무 최근이면 시세 확인이 어려움
en: Use is residential — commercial/office zoning is a risk
Any 'violation building' flag
The actual unit number matches the register (illegal subdivision)
Approval date — a very recent build makes valuation hard

q.en: Is it flagged as a violation building?
Is the zoning commercial or office rather than residential?

name.en: Landlord's ID (plus power of attorney and seal certificate if a proxy)

desc.ko: 신분증의 이름과 등기부등본 소유자가 일치해야 합니다. 대리인이면 인감증명서가 첨부된 위임장이 필수입니다.
desc.en: The ID must match the registered owner. A proxy must have a power of attorney with the owner's seal certificate attached.

ko: 대리인: 위임장 원본 + 3개월 내 인감증명서 + 대리인 신분증
en: ID name and birth date match the registered owner
Proxy: original power of attorney, seal certificate within 3 months, proxy's own ID
Confirm intent with the owner directly by video call
Refusal to let you photograph the ID is a warning

q.ko: 소유자가 아닌 대리인과 계약하는데 위임장·인감증명서가 없습니까?
q.en: Are you signing with a proxy who has no power of attorney or seal certificate?
Did they refuse to let you inspect or photograph the ID or documents?

name.en: Agent's registration, licence and indemnity certificate

where.ko: 중개사무소 벽면 게시 의무 / 시·군·구청 조회
where.en: Must be displayed in the office; verifiable at the district office

desc.ko: 중개를 통한 계약이라면 등록된 중개사인지 확인해야 사고 시 공제를 받을 수 있습니다.
desc.en: If an agent is involved, verify they are licensed — otherwise there is no indemnity cover if something goes wrong.

en: Look up the registration number with the district office
Indemnity certificate amount and validity (at least 200M won)
Agent's signature, seal and registration number on the contract
The office address actually exists

q.en: Have you not verified the agent's registration number yourself?

name.en: Landlord's national and local tax clearance certificates

where.ko: 임대인에게 요구 (2023년 법 개정으로 요구 가능)
where.en: Request from the landlord — legally requestable since the 2023 amendment

desc.ko: 세금 체납은 보증금보다 우선 변제됩니다. 체납액이 크면 경매 시 보증금을 못 받을 수 있습니다.
desc.en: Unpaid taxes rank ahead of your deposit. Large arrears mean you may recover nothing at auction.

ko: 임대인이 제출을 거부하는지 (거부 자체가 위험 신호)
en: Whether arrears exist
Whether the landlord refuses to provide it — refusal itself is a red flag

q.en: Did the landlord refuse to provide tax clearance certificates?

where.ko: 주민센터 — 임대차 계약 예정자도 발급 가능
where.en: Community centre — a prospective tenant may request it

desc.ko: 같은 집에 이미 전입신고된 세대가 있는지 확인합니다. 다가구 주택과 이중계약 확인에 필수입니다.
desc.en: Shows whether other households are already registered at the address. Essential for multi-unit buildings and detecting double leases.

ko: 선순위 보증금 총액 + 내 보증금이 시세를 넘지 않는지
en: How many tenants have priority over you
Whether their deposits plus yours exceed the property's value

q.ko: 선순위 임차인이 여러 명인데 그 보증금 총액을 모릅니까?
q.en: Are there prior tenants whose total deposits you don't know?

name.en: Standard residential lease contract plus special terms

desc.ko: 모든 약속은 특약사항에 글로 남겨야 합니다. 계약 후 당일 전입신고와 확정일자를 받으세요.
desc.en: Every promise must be written into the special terms. Do the move-in report and fixed-date stamp the same day.

ko: 특약: '잔금일까지 근저당 말소, 미이행 시 계약 무효·전액 반환'
특약: '전세보증보험 가입 불가 시 계약 무효·전액 반환'
특약: '임대인은 잔금일 다음날까지 추가 담보 설정 금지'
en: Clause: mortgage cleared by final payment day, else void with full refund
Clause: void with full refund if deposit insurance is refused
Clause: landlord may not add new liens until the day after final payment
Deposit, rent, maintenance fee, move-in date and term are all correct
Move-in report and fixed-date stamp at the community centre on signing day

q.en: Were you asked to delay the move-in report or fixed-date stamp?

q.ko: 구두 약속이 있는데 특약사항에 적지 않았습니까?
q.en: Are there verbal promises not written into the special terms?
Were you told deposit guarantee insurance isn't possible?
Were you asked to pay before signing the contract?
